messages:
Aisha (docs): Quick audit found inconsistent SDK snippets on Optimize pages (batching/caching/quant). Opening a small PR to sync. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1307
Priya (devex): Noticed Node uses old stream API; we should use the async iterator pattern in examples.
Sam (engineer): I'll drop a concise Python example for adaptive batching + prefix cache that is copy/paste-ready.
Sam (engineer): ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('Summarize briefly', model='redwood-2b', max_tokens=100, batch_policy='adaptive', cache_prefix_enabled=True)
print(resp.text)
```
Marcus (eng-ml): Also the quant profile names in docs don't match runtime logs (q4f vs q4_0). Add a mapping and a short migration note.
Aisha (docs): Good call. I'll add a YAML mapping and a one-line FAQ: "If your runtime shows 'q4f', use docs alias 'q4_0'."
support-bot: PR 1307 opened by @aisha/docs: "optimize: sync snippets + quant alias mapping"  CI: docs-lint passed
Priya (devex): Proposed TS stream snippet: ```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
for await (const chunk of client.stream.generate({ model: 'redwood-2b', input: 'Short summary' })) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text); }
```
Aisha (docs): Thanks all. Plan: Sam add Python + YAML, Priya update Node, Marcus quick sign-off on quant wording. I'll merge after approvals, target EOD tomorrow.
Marcus (eng-ml): Will review tonight.
Sam (engineer): Pushed snippets.
Aisha (docs): Merged after Marcus +1. Changelog: canonicalized quant aliases, refreshed snippets, added migration note.
